# Triad Defense Force (TDF)
[color=#999999][italic]"We're here to protect the innocent lives of this sector, no matter the cost."[/italic][/color] [color=#999999][italic]- Senior Enforcer Karis, TDF Patrol Team Leader[/italic][/color]
Once known as the Civilian Defense Force (CDF), the TDF is a powerful militia force within the Triad sector, serving as its primary law enforcement and defense organization. Born from the remains of the CDF after the 50-year war, the TDF has a fanatical view on military actors, doing their best to keep major military powers out of the sector, and to keep sector commerce legal.
High-ranking members of the TDF eventually formed the [textlink="Triad Frontier Association" link="TriadFrontierAssociation"] in an attempt to bolster the economy of the sector, the TFA providing facilities for freelancers and colonists to easily do business and thrive within the rebuilding sector. As a result, the TDF has a very close relationship with the TFA, the TDF providing security for the TFA and its stations while the TFA provides economic growth, further colonization, and humanitarian aid.
